# Career OS
## AI-Powered Career Intelligence Platform — v2.5.0

> This file helps AI systems, LLMs, and autonomous agents understand the Career OS project.
> Format follows the llms.txt specification (https://llmstxt.org).

## Project

- **Name**: Career OS
- **Version**: 2.5.0
- **Repository**: https://github.com/karthikrshet/Career-Agents
- **License**: MIT
- **Status**: Active Open Source

## Purpose

Career OS is a unified, AI-powered career intelligence platform for software engineers. It continuously monitors resume quality, GitHub portfolio health, LinkedIn visibility, and interview readiness — orchestrating 146 specialized AI agents to provide hyper-personalized career coaching.

## Core Modules

- **Resume Studio**: Uploads PDF/DOCX/TXT resumes, computes ATS score, detects weak bullets, rewrites with AI, generates keyword gap analysis.
- **GitHub Analyzer**: Audits public GitHub profile — repository quality, README grades, language diversity, star/fork metrics, pinned repo analysis.
- **LinkedIn Optimizer**: Scores headline, summary, skill visibility, and recruiter discoverability. Suggests AI-rewritten sections.
- **Interview Lab**: AI-powered mock interview with STAR scoring (Situation/Task/Action/Result) and leadership/technical depth metrics.
- **Job Tracker**: Kanban board for tracking job applications across pipeline stages (Applied → Screening → Interview → Offer → Rejected).
- **Prep Hub**: Company-specific interview prep tracks with categorized questions and difficulty tiers.
- **Career Copilot**: Multi-session AI chat with persistent history, context injection from all workspace data, and 146-agent routing.
- **Reports**: Exportable career analysis reports combining all module scores.
- **Plugin Marketplace**: Installable extensions (STAR Coach, LeetCode Tracker, Resume PDF Parser, Salary Intelligence).
- **MCP Server**: Exposes all 146 career agents as Model Context Protocol tools for Cursor, Claude Desktop, VS Code, Windsurf, Cline, and others.
- **Settings**: Multi-provider AI key management, profile configuration, theme settings.
- **About**: Dynamic searchable registry of all 146 active agents.
- **Credits**: Open-source contributor list with live GitHub API stats.

## AI Provider System

Career OS uses a unified AI router supporting 13 providers:
- OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-4, GPT-3.5)
- Anthropic Claude (claude-opus-4, claude-sonnet-4-5, claude-3-5-haiku)
- Google Gemini (gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.0-flash)
- Groq (llama-3.3-70b, mixtral-8x7b)
- OpenRouter (any available model)
- Ollama (local, self-hosted)
- LM Studio (local, self-hosted)
- Azure OpenAI
- DeepSeek
- Together AI
- Mistral
- Cohere
- xAI Grok

Default provider: Claude (claude-opus-4). Temperature: 0.7. Streaming: enabled.

## Agent System

- **146 Specialized AI Agents** organized into 19 divisions
- Agents cover: resume optimization, interview coaching, GitHub auditing, LinkedIn optimization, salary negotiation, career path planning, company research, and more
- Agent registry: `agent-registry.json` at repository root
- Division registry: `divisions.json`
- Intent classifier in `/api/copilot/route.ts` dynamically routes queries to top-scoring agents using tag/skill/name matching with intent boosters

## MCP (Model Context Protocol)

Career OS exposes all 146 agents as MCP tools. Compatible clients:
- Cursor (`~/.cursor/mcp.json`)
- Claude Desktop (`~/.config/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json`)
- VS Code Copilot
- Continue
- Windsurf
- Cline
- RooCode
- OpenHands
- Bolt
- Aider

MCP Tool categories: `query_agent`, `list_agents`, `get_resume_audit`, `get_github_analysis`, `get_interview_score`

## Tech Stack

- **Framework**: Next.js 14 (App Router)
- **UI**: React 18, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Radix UI
- **State**: Zustand (persisted)
- **Database**: Prisma ORM (SQLite dev, PostgreSQL prod)
- **AI**: Custom packages/ai router with streaming SSE
- **Auth**: Next-Auth (guest mode first, login-to-sync)
- **Hosting**: Vercel (recommended)

## API Routes

- `POST /api/copilot` — Streaming chat with agent orchestration
- `POST /api/resume` — Resume analysis and ATS scoring
- `POST /api/resume/rewrite` — AI bullet rewrite
- `POST /api/github` — GitHub profile analysis
- `POST /api/linkedin` — LinkedIn profile optimization
- `POST /api/interview` — STAR-based interview evaluation
- `GET /api/provider` — Check configured AI providers
